ordered_diagnoses: Giant cell tumor of the skull
Aneurysmal bone cyst of the skull

facts.raw_span: A man in his mid-30s
forehead mass initially thought to be a lipoma
appeared 1 year earlier after minor forehead trauma
slowly enlarged over the past 4 months without pain or other symptoms
extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of the left foot treated 9 years earlier
below‐knee amputation and adjuvant ifosfamide–doxorubicin chemotherapy
10 cm × 8 cm soft, compressible mass on the right forehead
gray, well‐circumscribed mass
palpable bony step‐off at the base
Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a mass arising from the right frontal diploic space
intracranial extension and possible involvement of the superior sagittal sinus
lytic lesion of the right frontal bone with hypodense soft‐tissue extension into the scalp
